component.name: Folio
component.summary: Offline vector handwriting and notes for Linux

description.p: Write pressure-sensitive notes with a stylus, organize notebooks, annotate PDFs and search titles, tags and typed text. Your original ink stays editable and private.
No account or cloud service is required.

Initial Folio release: editable vector handwriting, PDF notes, rendered LaTeX and offline step-by-step math. Includes custom window controls and fixes for saving, exports, selections, document validation and large notebooks. The Flatpak includes the CPU math solver and automatic verified OCR downloads, with Vulkan Q8 GPU acceleration and CPU fallback.
